_readme: Per-city candidate rosters for SpeedShield expansion. NOT fetched by the app. Pipeline: (1) adjudicate each roster against the city's official list (URLs in sources), (2) python3 scripts/build_city_drafts.py --geocode writes drafts/<city>.geocoded.json with sanity-gated coordinates, (3) tester pin-drops a sample / any flagged rows, (4) verified entries are pasted into MANUAL_CAMERAS in update_cameras.py, which is what goes live. Names follow the app convention 'X and Y: City' (speech stops at the colon). direction_deg -1 = omnidirectional; approaches are recorded for the record even though the alert is omnidirectional (Tempe precedent). Compiled 2026-09-02 from search results only -- every official page was network-blocked from the session; see confidence per entry.

chandler.status: ACTIVE - 'Currently, there are 12 intersections in Chandler equipped with photo enforcement cameras. These cameras monitor both red light and speed violations.' CONFIRMED VERBATIM 2026-09-17 (Claude for Chrome) from the city page; the linked camera map PDF (dated 2024-08-15, legend 'Camera (12)') has 12 unlabeled pins and NO directions, so approaches are unknown for every row -> omnidirectional is the only option. Page shows no date and no vans.

mesa.status: ACTIVE - official page lists 18 intersections with 'intersection safety cameras' (no approaches, no vans mentioned) plus school-zone speed camera CORRIDORS at 9 schools (fixed, 35 mph when flashing / 45 otherwise per earlier reporting). CONFIRMED VERBATIM 2026-09-17 (Claude for Chrome). A 2018-era 'Facts' paragraph on the same page says '21 red light cameras and 14 intersection speed cameras at 19 intersections' -- one more than the current list; the current list governs. The old mesaazpolice.gov 'facts' URL is DEAD (redirects to a not-found page).

paradise_valley.status: ACTIVE (first US photo-radar town) - SIX fixed photo-enforcement locations on the town's program page (map image alt text 'PV PE Map 2025'), red light + speed. CONFIRMED VERBATIM 2026-09-17 (Claude for Chrome). The 2020 brochure still said 'five intersections and 2 mobile units'; the 2025 map adds Tatum & Foothill (S/B) and shows Desert Jewel as N/B only, so the two Tatum sites north of Lincoln are a directional pair. Mobile program: a semi-marked police vehicle with a radar device, 24-hour stints, locations unpublished -> out of scope (Tempe precedent). School-zone units: not mentioned on the 2025 page.
sources: https://paradisevalleyaz.gov/DocumentCenter/View/3940/Press-Release-Photo-Enforcement (official, 2015-04-29: Lincoln&Tatum NB/SB + Halo EB/WB, Lincoln&Palo Cristi EB/WB, Lincoln&Mockingbird EB, Tatum&Desert Jewel NB/SB)
https://paradisevalleyaz.gov/DocumentCenter/View/1875/2d (official memo: 2006 amendment added dual systems at Tatum & McDonald, relocated a camera to Lincoln & Mockingbird)
